lines.text: Jesus sees a large crowd and orders a crossing of the sea, and a scribe offers to follow Him.
Jesus tells the scribe foxes have dens and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.
A disciple asks to first bury his mother, but Jesus says to follow Him and let the dead bury their own.
Jesus rebukes the winds and sea, it becomes perfectly calm, and the amazed men ask what kind of man He is.
